description: Cancel a payment with a reason, which is stored on the payment and shown in the audit log and the apartment ledger. On an already-cancelled payment the reason can be set or changed. paymentId accepts a full UUID or a unique prefix of one in this building.

buildingId.description: Building UUID. Either buildingId or buildingName is required.

buildingName.description: Building name, or an unambiguous substring of it, matched case-insensitively. Used when buildingId is omitted.

cancelReason.description: Why the payment is cancelled. Stored on the payment and shown in the audit log and the apartment ledger. On an already-cancelled payment it can be set or changed on its own.

paymentId.description: UUID of the payment, or a unique prefix of one in this building.

name: cancel_payment
title: Cancel payment
